observations.result: The production scrape exports HTTP counters but no ainrf_deprecated_route_calls_total series, so zero deprecated traffic cannot be claimed. The P0 dashboard and detailed bounded metric are ready for the next release observation window.

Production cumulative HTTP counters contain 45,254 /api requests. The only /v1 traffic is three unauthorized /v1/models probes; no root product-alias traffic was observed after excluding health, metrics, and documentation endpoints. The WebUI release configuration also fixes API_BASE to /api.
